name: HalfBridge_SSHI_Clamp
rationale: The previous SSHI_Bridge_Clamp is very close but fails on startup (too slow) and ripple (slightly too high). Startup is limited by the two-diode drop (0.5V) in the full bridge and the storage capacitor size. By moving to a half-bridge rectifier (D1, D2), we reduce the diode drop to 0.25V. Because the SSHI flip (L1, S1) effectively makes the piezo voltage positive during both half-cycles, a half-bridge can extract most of the energy while speeding up the cold start. This efficiency gain allows us to use a slightly larger storage capacitor C1 to resolve the ripple issue on S3 without violating the startup time limit on S4.
